data.name: Merridie
data.gender_notes: Merridie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Merridie is an Old English name derived from the words 'mer' (sea) and 'rida' (ruler or leader). This name is believed to be inspired by the sea goddesses Mermaids and Nereids. In Christian context, Merridie may symbolize the calming and nurturing influence of the sea and the divine feminine. The name Merridie carries the meaning “Sea goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Merridie usually hope their child will grow to embody sea goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the divine feminine and the calming influence of the sea.
data.etymology: Merridie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sea goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Merridie total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: Merridie is a beautiful, evocative name with Old English origins. While it has no direct historical or legendary significance within Christianity, its evocative meaning can inspire deep connections to the Christian faith.Imagery of the sea and its creatures abounds in the Bible, from the beginning of life in Genesis 1, to Jesus calming the stormy waters in the Gospels. This connection is further emphasized in various Christian legends and traditions, such as the Celtic and Anglican saints who are invoked to protect seafarers and fishermen. The name Merridie draws from this rich imagery, evoking the calm, nurturing presence of the sea and the divine providence that guards its depths.
data.spiritual_significance: Merridie can be seen as a spiritual name, invoking a sense of divine leadership and care. The Mer and Rida elements in the name point to the sea as a symbol of Psalm 46:2, which describes God as "beyond the raging of the seas." Merridie may serve as a reminder of the steadfast and comforting presence of God, even amidst storms and uncertainty. Additionally, as a reminder of the sea goddesses Mermaids and Nereids, Merridie can represent the feminine side of the divine, reflecting the nurturing nature of God, and the depths of His love and protection.
